cases.description: tsigState is TSIG_UNSIGNED (0). isSigned() should return false.
tsigState is TSIG_INTERMEDIATE (2). isSigned() should return false.
tsigState is TSIG_SIGNED (3). isSigned() should return true.
tsigState is TSIG_VERIFIED (1). isSigned() should return true.
tsigState is TSIG_FAILED (4). isSigned() should return true.
tsigState is an unexpected value (e.g., 5). isSigned() should return false.
tsigState is a negative value (-1). isSigned() should return false because only non‑negative defined states are considered signed.
tsigState is Integer.MAX_VALUE (2,147,483,647). isSigned() should return false as it is outside the defined signed states.
tsigState is Integer.MIN_VALUE (-2,147,483,648). isSigned() should return false because it is not a recognized signed state.
tsigState is an unexpected positive value (6). isSigned() should return false, confirming that only the five defined constants are treated as signed.
After invoking setTSIG(TSIG key) the Message should transition to TSIG_SIGNED state; isSigned() must return true.
After invoking setTSIG(TSIG key, error, querytsig) with a non‑zero error that forces TSIG_FAILED, isSigned() must still return true because TSIG_FAILED is considered signed.
